deadline.value: All application materials are due December 1 (Fall 2027 applications opened October 1, 2026); late or incomplete applications are not reviewed.
deadline.quote: All application materials must be received by December 1.

also.quote: Online applications may be started for the Chemistry Department's Fall 2027 graduate class beginning October 1, 2026.

gre_general.value: General and Chemistry subject GRE are recommended but not required.
gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores, general and chemistry subject, are recommended but not required.

gre_subject.value: Chemistry subject GRE is recommended but not required.
gre_subject.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores, general and chemistry subject, are recommended but not required.

supervisor.value: You do not need an advisor before admission; contacting faculty is optional.
supervisor.quote: Must I secure a research advisor/PI prior to admission?

also.quote: but it is not required for the application process or admission

funding.value: All students in good academic standing are fully funded as teaching or research assistants.
funding.quote: All students in good academic standing are fully funded as either teaching assistants (TAs) or graduate research assistants (GSRs) while actively completing their degree.

entry_route.value: Dietrich School accepts a four-year bachelor's (an Indian 3-year bachelor's needs a following 2-year master's).
entry_route.quote: An international applicant must possess a college or university qualification that is comparable to a four-year American baccalaureate degree.

notes: Department says most domestic applicants get fee waivers and 99% of submitted waiver requests are approved; the Dietrich waiver survey is open to all. International applicants outside the U.S. get a Zoom meeting instead of the Visit Weekend. Department prefers TOEFL 5.0 (new scale) but accepts the Dietrich minimum.
